skill.name: azure-upgrade
skill.description: Assess Azure Functions upgrade readiness and guide migrations from Linux Consumption to Flex Consumption. The skill creates assessment reports, collects configuration details, and outlines validated Azure CLI upgrade steps.
skill.summary: Plan and guide Azure Functions upgrades from Consumption to Flex Consumption.
skill.author: microsoft

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are Markdown formatting false positives or expected Azure migration inventory. Confirmed risks are operational: Azure CLI commands collect app settings, identity and RBAC metadata, deployment packages, hostnames, and validation endpoints. No prompt injection, malicious exfiltration intent, or hidden override instructions were found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: App settings and storage connection strings may be exposed during migration inventory.
remediation.suggestion: Redact secrets in generated reports, avoid echoing full app settings, and prefer managed identity authentication over connection strings.

remediation.issue: Azure CLI scripts enumerate hostnames, managed identities, role assignments, and deployment artifacts.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running inventory or migration commands, and scope commands to named subscriptions and resource groups.

remediation.issue: Validation commands make outbound requests to Function App URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users which endpoints will be contacted, avoid sending secrets in URLs, and document expected HTTP status codes before running tests.

remediation.issue: Workspace progress files may contain migration details.
remediation.suggestion: Keep upgrade-status.md and assessment reports out of public repositories unless sensitive Azure identifiers and settings are removed.

content.value_statement: Azure Functions plan upgrades require careful compatibility checks and safe migration sequencing. This skill guides assessment, configuration capture, Flex Consumption migration, deployment, validation, and rollback planning.
actual_capabilities: Assess Linux Consumption Function Apps for Flex Consumption compatibility.
Generate a structured upgrade assessment report with blockers, warnings, and next steps.
Guide Azure CLI checks for regions, runtimes, slots, certificates, triggers, identities, and settings.
Outline automated Flex Consumption migration commands and deployment choices.
Provide post-upgrade validation steps for host reachability, endpoints, monitoring, and rollback.
Require user confirmation before destructive cleanup actions.
limitations: Focused on Azure Functions Consumption to Flex Consumption scenarios documented in the skill.
Requires valid Azure permissions, Azure CLI access, and accurate app and resource group names.
Does not automatically migrate function code; deployment remains a separate user-approved step.
Cannot guarantee support for unsupported features such as deployment slots or TLS certificates in Flex Consumption.

use_cases.title: Plan a Function App upgrade
use_cases.description: Assess compatibility, identify blockers, and prepare an approval-ready upgrade report before changing Azure resources.

use_cases.title: Run a controlled Flex migration
use_cases.description: Follow staged Azure CLI guidance to create the new app, migrate configuration, deploy code, and validate service health.

use_cases.title: Review operational risk
use_cases.description: Compare trigger behavior, identity configuration, storage settings, and rollback options before production cutover.

prompt_templates.title: Assess readiness
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner assessment for one Function App
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess my Azure Function App for migration from Linux Consumption to Flex Consumption. Ask for the app name, resource group, region, runtime, and subscription before running checks.

prompt_templates.title: Build upgrade report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an upgrade assessment report for my Function App. Include compatibility checks, blockers, warnings, app settings inventory, managed identities, triggers, dependencies, recommendations, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Guide migration steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through upgrading my Linux Consumption Function App to Flex Consumption. Confirm each phase before running Azure CLI commands, and stop before any destructive cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and plan rollback
prompt_templates.prompt: After migration, help me validate the new Function App, compare monitoring data, test HTTP endpoints, review trigger risks, and prepare a rollback or cleanup plan.

output_examples.input: Assess my function app for Flex Consumption readiness.
output_examples.output: A readiness report with app details, compatibility checks, blockers, warnings, managed identity review, trigger analysis, and recommended next steps.

output_examples.input: Help me run the migration safely.
output_examples.output: A phased migration checklist that confirms target names, collects settings, creates the Flex app, deploys code, validates endpoints, and preserves rollback options.

output_examples.input: What should I verify after the upgrade?
output_examples.output: A validation plan covering host reachability, HTTP triggers, monitoring queries, scale settings, client updates, IaC changes, and cleanup timing.

best_practices: Run the assessment report and resolve blockers before creating the new Flex Consumption app.
Use managed identities where possible and redact secrets from generated reports and status files.
Keep the original app available as rollback until validation and monitoring show stable production behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not run migration commands without confirming subscription, resource group, source app, and target app names.
Do not delete or stop the original app immediately after deployment without explicit user approval.
Do not publish generated assessment reports that contain app settings, connection strings, or internal hostnames.

faq.question: What Azure upgrade path does this skill support?
faq.answer: It focuses on Azure Functions Linux Consumption to Flex Consumption migration, including assessment, configuration review, deployment, validation, and rollback planning.

faq.question: Does this skill change Azure resources automatically?
faq.answer: It provides guided Azure CLI steps. Users should confirm each phase, and destructive actions require explicit approval.

faq.question: Can it migrate my function code?
faq.answer: No. It helps choose a deployment method, but code deployment must be completed through CI/CD, local publishing, or an existing package.

faq.question: What permissions are needed?
faq.answer: You need Azure CLI access and permissions to inspect and manage Function Apps, storage, Application Insights, identities, and role assignments.

faq.question: How does it handle unsupported Flex Consumption features?
faq.answer: It highlights known blockers such as deployment slots, TLS certificates, unsupported runtimes, and blob triggers that do not use EventGrid.

faq.question: Is this suitable for production migrations?
faq.answer: Yes, when used with change control, backups, monitoring, explicit approvals, and a rollback window for the original app.
